_description: BTRC-licensed International Gateway (IGW) operators: licensed to carry international phone calls, not internet traffic. ASN as key. Used to label networks, not to classify them as internet gateways.
_source: BTRC licence list, IGW row: https://btrc.gov.bd/pages/static-pages/6922ddd6933eb65569e1691d ('International Gateway (IGW) License List as on 30-10-2024', 24 companies; copy in docs/List of IGW Service Providers License.pdf)
_note: An ASN is listed when its RIPEstat holder name (or, for HRC's AS55406, its registered address) matches the licensee; licensees often hold separate ISP ASNs, which are not listed. No ASN found for First Communications Limited, Roots Communication Ltd. and Sigma Telecom Limited; AS147179 'Global Voice.Com' was not matched to Global Voice Telecom Limited. BTCL also holds an IGW licence; its ASNs are on btrc_iig_licenses.json.
_policy: Licences issued 2008-2012 are valid until 2027-04-11 (Venus Telecom 2027-05-02, LR Telecom 2033-10-29) per BTRC's list. The Telecommunication Network and Licensing Policy 2025 ends IGW licences as they expire.
